floor_history.headline: Recon: stale 119 migration pin killed — honest floor is 57/173 (insn-count already exact); residual is one OR-association copy + the count-1 comparand carrier, both pass-attributed from the .loop dump

frontier.hypothesis: The target_color OR-association is the single extra instruction (the trailing `move s6,a0`), and a flat single-expression spelling with the -0x8000 constant physically inside the green term reproduces the target's grouping without any sanctioned-family construct.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 fold-const.c reassociates a constant operand leftwards through an associative `|` chain built by `|=` accumulation; combine/jump2 then fails to coalesce the final OR pseudo into the callee-save holding target_color, leaving a copy.
frontier.next_probe: Measure `target_color = ((u32)r >> 3) | (((g & 0xF8) << 2) | (s32)-0x8000) | ((b & 0xF8) << 7);` as a single expression with no `|=`, plus the blue-first variant, then read tmp/grind/func_8003DE14/dumps/code6cac_c2.combine for func_8003DE14 to see whether the trailing copy is a combine artifact or a greg artifact. Pure ordinary C, no family question, cheap.

frontier.hypothesis: No sanctioned-family construct is needed for the `count - 1` comparand at all — the inline `if (i == count - 1)` form (v1, 66) hoisted via the `already_moved` / `m->forces` clause of loop.c:1631, not the arithmetic clause, so a different ordinary-C shape can leave it inline the way the target does.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c:1631 `if (already_moved[regno] || (threshold * savings * m->lifetime) >= insn_count || (m->forces && m->forces->done && n_times_used[m->forces->regno] == 1))`. The dump already proves the arithmetic clause is FALSE here (threshold <= 56 vs insn_count 57 for life-1/savings-1 movables), so whatever hoisted v1's comparand came from one of the other two clauses.
frontier.next_probe: Re-run `pwsh tools/grinder/dump.ps1 func_8003DE14` with v1 applied (memory/grind/func_8003DE14/rejected/v1-ordinary-c-count-minus-1-inline-hoisted.c) and read the `;; Function func_8003DE14` .loop diagnostics for the pseudo holding `count - 1`: is it listed, and under which clause was it moved? That single read decides whether this function needs any /* FAKE */ construct. Do it BEFORE proposing one.

frontier.hypothesis: The r/g/b callee-save rotation (target s5/s4/s3 + s6, build s6/s5/s4 + s3) is a downstream cascade of the two items above and not an independent lever.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 global.c allocno ordering — the target_color pseudo's priority relative to the three colour-component pseudos shifts when the OR chain shape or the comparand's live range changes.
frontier.next_probe: After F1 and F2 land, run tools/ra_solver/inverse_compose.py classify on the .greg allocation for the four pseudos to get a typed REACHABLE / FORECLOSED verdict with ranked C-lever vectors, instead of guessing at declaration-order spellings (which K4 already showed to be inert here).
